{{Quote|Mon Mothma, I am forced to disagree. The course you are embarking on is foolhardy. I request that you postpone and reconsider the attack on Milvayne.|[[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] to [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]|<ref name="DoO" />}}
'''Milvayne''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Gyrica system/Legends|Gyrica system]]<ref name="DoO" /> of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Milvayne was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] and essential to the Empire's hold on the Gyrica system. Shortly prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] proposed an [[Attack on Milvayne|attack]] on Milvayne in the near future, which was supported by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] before his [[Death/Legends|death]]. Following the Battle of Yavin, Mon Mothma ordered the attack to be carried out. [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]], who rarely saw [[Eye/Legends|eye]] to eye with Mon Mothma, believed that the planet possessed an [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]] base rather than a mere Imperial [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]], and that the attack was an impossible, suicidal undertaking. The quarrel over the attack ultimately led to the split between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] and [[Garm Bel Iblis's movement|Bel Iblis's forces]].<ref name="DoO" /> The battle eventually occurred but Rebel forces were defeated as expected by Bel Iblis.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
